incident-bot: INCIDENT 3956789012 - embeddings route error spike (5xx + timeouts). Paging oncall @maria. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-surge :rotating_light:

maria: Taking this. Looking at dashboards now. 

jamal: seeing a big increase in tail latency from embeddings-prod us-west-2, 95p -> 8s. Errors are mostly 503 from gpu-proxy.

maria: Confirmed. Looks correlated with a traffic pattern from a single heavy-customer tokenization batch. Starting triage: 1) identify offending API key 2) quick mitigation (quota/routing) 3) deeper root cause.

samir: I can pull logs. Which route exactly? /v1/embeddings?

maria: yes, /v1/embeddings. Also rerank route showing some spillover but much smaller.

kai: @maria we have a short mitigation we use in runbook: carve dedicated per-route quota and cap burst for embeddings. Propose: 1) apply per-endpoint QPS limit to embeddings route at 40 rps cluster-wide 2) temporarily reduce rerank to 20% of its usual quota 3) enable aggressive prefix KV caching for embeddings responses. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: Good plan. Need an API call. Samir, can you run the quota surgery? Use the internal control plane:

samir: running now. Payload: 
```
POST https://internal-control/api/v1/quotas/adjust
{
  "scope": "route",
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "limit": "40rps",
  "mode": "enforced",
  "note": "Emergency mitigation - embeddings surge 3956789012"
}
```

samir: applied enforcement on cluster us-west-2. Response: 200 OK.

jamal: Confirming traffic drop on embedding hosts. Error rate down by 70% and latency 95p moving to ~1.8s.

maria: Now carving rerank:
```
POST https://internal-control/api/v1/quotas/adjust
{ "route": "/v1/rerank", "limit": "20rps", "mode": "enforced", "note": "Emergency spare capacity for embeddings" }
```

ops-runner: rerank limit applied. Positive effect: embeddings latency improving further.

kai: Also toggled noncritical feature flag for batch-rerank for select partners (disabled) to reduce load. Sent prodflag update.

maria: Quick customer impact stats from metrics: ~12 customers experienced >2x latency, 3 customers hit 5xxs consistently for ~4m before mitigation. No customer data lost. Notifying CS for those 3.

jamal: Oncall handoff in 20m to @jamal (taking over) — I'll continue monitoring, collect logs for root cause and follow-up.

maria: Thanks. Post-incident immediate actions: 1) keep quotas enforced for 15m, 2) collect detailed per-key traffic and tokenization patterns, 3) prepare rollback plan (remove enforcement) once stable.

jamal: Handing over now. Summary for next shift: embeddings route surge caused by a single customer's large tokenization/batch; live mitigations were per-route quota cap + rerank carve + feature flag disable. Latency and errors reduced to baseline. I'll run a replay of the offending key in staging to reproduce.

maria: Ack. Please create an incident ticket and link to this thread. We should update runbook with a recommended per-endpoint emergency slate (e.g., default emergency cap policy and automation to detect single-key batch surges).

jamal: Created INC-3956789012 in JIRA and added initial RCA notes. Assigning to eng-ml and platform for follow-up.

samir: dropping logs bundle to incident ticket.

kai: Nice work. Postmortem owners: eng-ml (model tokenization), eng-runtime (gpu-proxy), product (customer comms).

maria: Closing the live mitigation: removing enforced rerank cap and feature flag after steady 30m. Leaving embeddings limit at 40rps for now until postmortem proposals.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident 3956789012 now in "mitigated" state. Oncall handoff @jamal.

jamal: Will schedule a follow-up sync in 48h to decide longer-term quota policy and possible auto-sculpting automation. :calendar:

maria: Thanks everyone. Small action items created.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: on the mitigation messages)
